upstream.adaptation: CoMaps module/settings/container names; async native callback waits; incoming file writes use staged payload and typed core acknowledgement instead of optimistic canonical reload. No second legacy resolver.

added_or_retained_adaptation_regressions.boundary: Real resolver and state mock establish A then incoming B; actual manager result handler confirms actual terminal fingerprint, leaves A on skip/failure, rejects old-session payload with acknowledgement, ignores old terminal. Last case uses real filesystem writer and next queued upload to prove queue unblocks.
Unknown account identity does not erase common-base history.
Transfer follows actual metadata URL rather than constructing source from display name; unrelated same-name file untouched.

Immutable coordinated source staging; acknowledgement barrier before next upload; unavailable source does not block queue; owned temporary snapshot lifetime. Tests retained from previous patch series with new typed contract.

Actual asynchronous disk persistence, reopen and account-reset ordering. Opaque synthetic NSCoding-only account identity compares isEqual; equal accounts with unequal archives preserve base, different account discards it.
Real DispatchSource lifecycle release in active, paused, stopped, and stop/start/pause/resume/stop states; no lifetime-retaining workaround.
Apple ubiquity identity token contract does not require NSSecureCoding; archive/decode preserves semantic identity.
Existing real native bridge scenario adapted to validator and explicit Applied result; target memory, bytes and mtime checked before callback acknowledgement. Other nine folder tests unchanged.

superseded_previous_tests.reason: Old date-only resolver API and expectations conflict with canonical common-base reconciliation. All 21 are replaced by the 39 upstream resolver scenarios. A newer mtime alone intentionally no longer selects a destructive winner.

replacement_groups.old: Initial sync / empty directory / nonconflicting create / not-yet-downloaded tests
Newer cloud / newer local / changed local / changed cloud tests
Unchanged, item addition and removal snapshots

previous_initial_conflict_cases.replacement: Same named test retained in SynchronizationFileWriterTests

Resolver.testFileIsReconciledWhenItsContentBecomesKnown plus Writer.testUnreadableFileIsNotCreatedOverAgain. Canonical engine defers unknown hashes instead of overwriting; data-preservation intent retained, decision policy safer.

superseded_previous_tests.previous_staging_gate_methods: All four retained under SynchronizationIncomingFileWriterTests, adapted to canonical writer event/typed acknowledgement API.

integration_coverage_owned_by_other_agen.native_core: 48 cases planned: prior33, typed incoming validator/delete10, failed autosave/persisted revision5. Real entrypoint tests cover queued A/incoming B/local C, open edit, unrelated C, teardown, delete/recreate, validator mismatch/failure, save failure/recovery, older queued save cannot overwrite newer synchronous save.
integration_coverage_owned_by_other_agen.search: 11 native cases unchanged by this test bundle.
integration_coverage_owned_by_other_agen.unrelated_iOS: Parent counts 62 unchanged scenarios, including the 10 folder order methods; parent final plan is authoritative.

verification.separate_Swift_typecheck: 9 actual production files +12 actual test/mock files; app/XCTest surfaces stubbed; PASS
verification.native_XCTest: Pending remote CI, no local Xcode available.
verification.real_cloud_monitor: Not run locally: metadata query uses actual ubiquity scope even with mock FileManager. Run only in isolated CI simulator.

residual_boundaries: Accepted native incoming work may finish after stop/account change, per upstream accepted-write semantics; stale terminal cannot establish common base. Unaccepted old-session payload is skipped and acknowledged. No newly invented core cancellation protocol.

OS NSFileVersion conflict enumeration/resolution still requires simulator or real-device coverage; current upstream22 writer cases exercise preservation/collision and metadata guards but do not provide a direct NSFileVersion conflict fixture seam.

Known-unsaved outgoing preflight is source-reviewed and native core getter tests cover its guard; manager's concrete BookmarksManager has unavailable initializer, so no new mock/protocol architecture was introduced solely for another test.
Real three-device iCloud/account/quota and app lifecycle exercise remains necessary after native CI.
Common-base is raw-byte SHA256 per filename; pre-existing differently named duplicate folders and semantically equal but byte-different KML are not automatically deduplicated.
